function: Excluded (survey): a tutorial on the convergence of existing AirComp-based FedAvg algorithms, not a proposed method. p. 1: "In this tutorial, we focus on FL via over-the-air computation (AirComp)".
notes: Reason survey, p. 1: "In this tutorial, we focus on FL via over-the-air computation (AirComp)"; p. 2: "motivates this comprehensive tutorial on the convergence of AirFL"; p. 4 Fig. 1 "Taxonomy of this tutorial". The work analyzes the convergence of existing algorithms (p. 12: AirFedAvg-M is used in [49], [53], ...) with the COTAF denoising factor of [53]; it proposes no new aggregation or transceiver design. If the reviewer judged it a research article, the next code would be system: p. 6 "a single-antenna edge server and N single-antenna edge devices" (SISO, no RIS, area 7); multi-antenna and RIS appear only as discussed extensions (p. 15, p. 18). PDF is arXiv 2310.10089v1 with the title Over-the-Air Federated Learning and Optimization; it does not print the DOI.
